title: Баба Яга на каникулах
overview: This time, Baba Yaga isn’t setting out to save the world; she’s simply heading off for a vacation in the countryside to visit her granddaughter, Marusya. At the ancestral home of Marya the Artful, the family is preparing to celebrate the girl’s eighth birthday—a milestone that, by tradition, marks the awakening of magical powers within their lineage. But even on holiday, Yaga finds no respite from the forces of evil. While the adults bicker with a goat, a fence, and some robotic vacuum cleaners, and the children compete in a contest of good deeds—all amidst a village-wide celebration filled with songs and festivities—the villains are busy laying a new trap for Yaga.

title: Отцовский клуб
overview: Dima is preparing for the birth of his first child and is confident that he has thought of everything. But on the most important day of his life, things begin to spiral out of control: the baby arrives early, and, just before that, his own father—who had vanished more than twenty years ago—suddenly reappears. At the maternity hospital, Dima finds himself in a waiting room with four other men, all of whom are completely different from one another. Andrei, thirty years later, is getting a second chance at fatherhood, yet he fears repeating the mistakes of the past. Young DJ Arseny must learn to embrace not only his own child but also the son of the woman he loves. Gena, a hot-headed construction worker, has spent years trying to have a child with his wife, while Mikhalych has decided to become a father later in life. Over the course of a few hours, these chance acquaintances argue, bicker, share their deepest personal fears, and end up forming their own "Fathers' Club."

title: Фунтик
overview: Funtik is the most famous performer in Madame Belladonna’s circus. Every evening, the little piglet collects money—ostensibly to help him find his parents—unaware that Belladonna has been pocketing all the earnings for herself. Upon discovering the truth, Funtik runs away and encounters new friends: a former circus performer named Uncle Mokus and his resourceful niece, Bambina. Together, they embark on an exciting journey, during which Funtik learns for the first time what true friendship and family really mean. Meanwhile, acting on Belladonna’s orders, the quick-witted Foxtrot and his team of top-notch detectives are already in hot pursuit of the fugitive.

title: Wings of Freedom
overview: Home-loving eagle Salana is forced out of her jungle bird colony to join Pirro, an intrepid swift and member of the Animal Air Force. This unlikely duo embarks on an epic, high-flying adventure to stop a malevolent AI and save the world.

title: Любопытная Варвара. Тайны востока
overview: Varya, a girl who knows everything about forensics and dreams of becoming a great detective like her grandfather, and her best friend Vasya, who is ready to do anything for adventure, will once again prove that childhood curiosity and faith in goodness are stronger than any difficulty.
